18:1.t: Praise be to God, Who hath sent to His Servant the Book, and hath allowed therein no Crookedness

18:2.t: in order that He may warn
of a terrible Punishment from Him, and that He may give Glad Tidings to the Believers who work righteous deeds, that they shall have a goodly Reward

18:3.t: Wherein they shall remain for ever

18:4.t: Further, that He may warn those
who say, "God hath begotten a son

18:5.t: No knowledge have they of such a thing, nor had their fathers. It is a grievous thing that issues from their mouths as a saying what they say is nothing but falsehood

18:6.t: Thou wouldst only, perchance, fret thyself to death, following after them, in grief, if they believe not in this Message

18:7.t: That which is on earth we have made but as a glittering show for the earth, in order that We may test them - as to which of them are best in conduct

18:8.t: Verily what is on earth we shall make but as dust and dry soil

18:9.t: Or dost thou reflect that the Companions of the Cave and of the Inscription were wonders among Our Sign

18:10.t: Behold, the youths betook themselves to the Cave: they said, "Our Lord! bestow on us Mercy from Thyself, and dispose of our affair for us in the right way

18:11.t: over their ears, for a number of years, in the Cave,

18:12.t: Then We roused them, in order to test which of the two parties was best at calculating the term of years they had tarried

18:13.t: We relate to thee their story in truth: they were youths who believed in their Lord, and We advanced them in guidance

18:14.t: We gave strength to their hearts: Behold, they stood up and said: "Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and of the earth: never shall we call upon any god other than Him: if we did, we should indeed have uttered an enormity

18:15.t: These our people have taken for worship gods other than Him: why do they not bring forward an authority clear
for what they do? Who doth more wrong than such as invent a falsehood against God

18:16.t: When ye turn away from them and the things they worship other than God, betake yourselves to the Cave: Your Lord will shower His mercies on you and disposes of your affair towards comfort and ease

18:17.t: Thou wouldst have seen the sun, when it rose, declining to the right from their Cave, and when it set, turning away from them to the left, while they lay in the open space in the midst of the Cave. Such are among the Signs of God: He whom God, guides is rightly guided; but he whom God leaves to stray,- for him wilt thou find no protector to lead him to the Right Way

18:18.t: Thou wouldst have deemed them awake, whilst they were asleep, and We turned them on their right and on their left sides: their dog stretching forth his two fore-legs on the threshold: if thou hadst come up on to them, thou wouldst have certain ly turned back from them in flight, and wouldst certainly have been filled with terror of them

18:19.t: , that they might question each other. Said one of them, "How long have ye stayed
a day, or part of a day."
knows best how long ye have stayed here.... Now send ye then one of you with this money of yours to the town: let him find out which is the best food
and bring some to you, that
satisfy your hunger therewith: And let him b ehave with care and courtesy, and let him not inform any one about you

18:20.t: For if they should come upon you, they would stone you or force you to return to their cult, and in that case ye would never attain prosperity

18:21.t: Thus did We make their case known to the people, that they might know that the promise of God is true, and that there can be no doubt about the Hour of Judgment. Behold, they dispute among themselves as to their affair.
said, "Construct a building over them": Their Lord knows best about them: those who prevailed over their affair said, "Let us surely build a place of worship over them

18:22.t: say they were three, the dog being the fourth among them;
say they were five, the dog being the sixth,- doubtfully guessing at the unknown;
say they were seven, the dog being the eighth. Say thou: "My Lord knoweth best their number; It is but few that know their
." Enter not, therefore, into controversies concerning them, except on a matter that is clear, nor consult any of them about

18:23.t: Nor say of anything, "I shall be sure to do so and so tomorrow

18:24.t: Without adding, "So please God!" and call thy Lord to mind when thou forgettest, and say, "I hope that my Lord will guide me ever closer
than this to the right road

18:25.t: So they stayed in their Cave three hundred years, and

18:26.t: Say: "God knows best how long they stayed: with Him is
the secrets of the heavens and the earth: how clearly He sees, how finely He hears
! They have no protector other than Him; nor does He share His Command wit h any person whatsoever

18:27.t: what has been revealed to thee of the Book of thy Lord: none can change His Words, and none wilt thou find as a refuge other than Him

18:28.t: And keep thy soul content with those who call on their Lord morning and evening, seeking His Face; and let not thine eyes pass beyond them, seeking the pomp and glitter of this Life; no obey any whose heart We have permitted to neglect the rem embrance of Us, one who follows his own desires, whose case has gone beyond all bounds

18:29.t: Say, "The truth is from your Lord": Let him who will believe, and let him who will, reject
: for the wrong-doers We have prepared a Fire whose

, like the walls and roof of a tent, will hem them in: if they implore relief t hey will be granted water like melted brass, that will scald their faces, how dreadful the drink! How uncomfortable a couch to recline on

18:30.t: As to those who believe and work righteousness, verily We shall not suffer to perish the reward of any who do a

18:31.t: For them will be Gardens of Eternity; beneath them rivers will flow; they will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold, and they will wear green garments of fine silk and heavy brocade: They will recline therein on raised thrones. How good t he recompense! How beautiful a couch to recline on

18:32.t: Set forth to them the parable of two men: for one of them We provided two gardens of grape-vines and surrounded them with date palms; in between the two We placed corn-fields

18:33.t: Each of those gardens brought forth its produce, and failed not in the least therein: in the midst of them We caused a river to flow

18:34.t: was the produce this man had: he said to his companion, in the course of a mutual argument: "more wealth have I than you, and more honour and power in

18:35.t: He went into his garden in a state
unjust to his soul: He said, "I deem not that this will ever perish

18:36.t: Nor do I deem that the Hour
come: Even if I am brought back to my Lord, I shall surely find

18:37.t: His companion said to him, in the course of the argument with him: "Dost thou deny Him Who created thee out of dust, then out of a sperm-drop, then fashioned thee into a man

18:38.t: for my part that He is God, My Lord, and none shall I associate with my Lord

18:39.t: Why didst thou not, as thou wentest into thy garden, say: 'God's will
! There is no power but with God!' If thou dost see me less than thee in wealth and sons

18:40.t: It may be that my Lord will give me something better than thy garden, and that He will send on thy garden thunderbolts

18:41.t: Or the water of the garden will run off underground so that thou wilt never be able to find it

18:42.t: , and he remained twisting and turning his hands over what he had spent on his property, which had
tumbled to pieces to its very foundations, and he could only say, "Woe is me! Wo uld I had never ascribed partners to my Lord and Cherisher

18:43.t: Nor had he numbers to help him against God, nor was he able to deliver himself

18:44.t: protection comes from God, the True One. He is the Best to reward, and the Best to give success

18:45.t: Set forth to them the similitude of the life of this world: It is like the rain which we send down from the skies: the earth's vegetation absorbs it, but soon it becomes dry stubble, which the winds do scatter: it is
God who prevails ove r all things

18:46.t: Wealth and sons are allurements of the life of this world: But the things that endure, good deeds, are best in the sight of thy Lord, as rewards, and best as

18:47.t: One Day We shall remove the mountains, and thou wilt see the earth as a level stretch, and We shall gather them, all together, nor shall We leave out any one of them

18:48.t: And they will be marshalled before thy Lord in ranks,
as We created you first: aye, ye thought We shall not fulfil the appointment made to you to meet

18:49.t: ; and thou wilt see the sinful in great terror because of what is

therein; they will say, "Ah! woe to us! what a Book is this! It leaves out nothing small or great, but takes account thereof!" They will find all that they did, placed before them: And not one will thy Lord treat with injustice

18:50.t: Behold! We said to the angels, "Bow down to Adam": They bowed down except Iblis. He was one of the Jinns, and he broke the Command of his Lord. Will ye then take him and his progeny as protectors rather than Me? And they are enemies to you! Ev il would be the exchange for the wrong-doers

18:51.t: I called them not to witness the creation of the heavens and the earth, nor
their own creation: nor is it for helpers such as Me to take as lead

18:52.t: One Day He will say, "Call on those whom ye thought to be My partners," and they will call on them, but they will not listen to them; and We shall make for them a place of common perdition

18:53.t: And the Sinful shall see the fire and apprehend that they have to fall therein: no means will they find to turn away therefrom

18:54.t: We have explained in detail in this Qur'an, for the benefit of mankind, every kind of similitude: but man is, in most things, contentious

18:55.t: And what is there to keep back men from believing, now that Guidance has come to them, nor from praying for forgiveness from their Lord, but that
the ways of the ancients be repeated with them, or the Wrath be brought to them f ace to face

18:56.t: We only send the apostles to give Glad Tidings and to give warnings: But the unbelievers dispute with vain argument, in order therewith to weaken the truth, and they treat My Signs as a jest, as also the fact that they are warned

18:57.t: And who doth more wrong than one who is reminded of the Signs of his Lord, but turns away from them, forgetting the

which his hands have sent forth? Verily We have set veils over their hearts lest they should understand this, and over their ears, deafness, if thou callest them to guidance, even then will they never accept guidance

18:58.t: But your Lord is Most forgiving, full of Mercy. If He were to call them
to account for what they have earned, then surely He would have earned, then surely He would have hastened their punishment: but they have their appointed time, beyond which they will find no refuge

18:59.t: Such were the populations we destroyed when they committed iniquities; but we fixed an appointed time for their destruction

18:60.t: Behold, Moses said to his attendant, "I will not give up until I reach the junction of the two seas or
I spend years and years in travel

18:61.t: But when they reached the Junction, they forgot
their Fish, which took its course through the sea

18:62.t: , Moses said to his attendant: "Bring us our early meal; truly we have suffered much fatigue at this

18:63.t: when we betook ourselves to the rock? I did indeed forget
the Fish: none but Satan made me forget to tell
about it: it took its course through the sea in a marvellous way

18:64.t: Moses said: "That was what we were seeking after:" So they went back on their footsteps, following

18:65.t: So they found one of Our servants, on whom We had bestowed Mercy from Ourselves and whom We had taught knowledge from Our own Presence

18:66.t: Moses said to him: "May I follow thee, on the footing that thou teach me something of the
Truth which thou hast been taught

18:67.t: said: "Verily thou wilt not be able to have patience with me

18:68.t: And how canst thou have patience about things about which thy understanding is not complete

18:69.t: Moses said: "Thou wilt find me, if God so will,
patient: nor shall I disobey thee in aught

18:70.t: The other said: "If then thou wouldst follow me, ask me no questions about anything until I myself speak to thee concerning it

18:71.t: So they both proceeded: until, when they were in the boat, he scuttled it. Said Moses: "Hast thou scuttled it in order to drown those in it? Truly a strange thing hast thou done

18:72.t: He answered: "Did I not tell thee that thou canst have no patience with me

18:73.t: Moses said: "Rebuke me not for forgetting, nor grieve me by raising difficulties in my case

18:74.t: Then they proceeded: until, when they met a young man, he slew him. Moses said: "Hast thou slain an innocent person who had slain none? Truly a foul

18:75.t: He answered: "Did I not tell thee that thou canst have no patience with me

18:76.t: said: "If ever I ask thee about anything after this, keep me not in thy company: then wouldst thou have received

18:77.t: Then they proceeded: until, when they came to the inhabitants of a town, they asked them for food, but they refused them hospitality. They found there a wall on the point of falling down, but he set it up straight.
said: "If thou hadst wished, surely thou couldst have exacted some recompense for it

18:78.t: He answered: "This is the parting between me and thee: now will I tell thee the interpretation of
over which thou wast unable to hold patience

18:79.t: As for the boat, it belonged to certain men in dire want: they plied on the water: I but wished to render it unserviceable, for there was after them a certain king who seized on every boat by force

18:80.t: As for the youth, his parents were people of Faith, and we feared that he would grieve them by obstinate rebellion and ingratitude

18:81.t: So we desired that their Lord would give them in exchange

18:82.t: As for the wall, it belonged to two youths, orphans, in the Town; there was, beneath it, a buried treasure, to which they were entitled: their father had been a righteous man: So thy Lord desired that they should attain their age of full stren gth and get out their treasure - a mercy
from thy Lord. I did it not of my own accord. Such is the interpretation of
over which thou wast unable to hold patience

18:83.t: They ask thee concerning Zul-qarnain. Say, "I will rehearse to you something of his story

18:84.t: Verily We established his power on earth, and We gave him the ways and the means to all ends

18:86.t: Until, when he reached the setting of the sun, he found it set in a spring of murky water: Near it he found a People: We said: "O Zul-qarnain!
either to punish them, or to treat them with kindness

18:87.t: He said: "Whoever doth wrong, him shall we punish; then shall he be sent back to his Lord; and He will punish him with a punishment unheard-of

18:88.t: But whoever believes, and works righteousness,- he shall have a goodly reward, and easy will be his task as We order it by our Command

18:90.t: Until, when he came to the rising of the sun, he found it rising on a people for whom We had provided no covering protection against the sun

18:91.t: as they were: We completely understood what was before him

18:93.t: between two mountains, he found, beneath them, a people who scarcely understood a word

18:94.t: They said: "O Zul-qarnain! the Gog and Magog
do great mischief on earth: shall we then render thee tribute in order that thou mightest erect a barrier between us and them

18:95.t: in which my Lord has established me is better
: I will erect a strong barrier between you and them

18:96.t: Bring me blocks of iron." At length, when he had filled up the space between the two steep mountain-sides, He said, "Blow
" Then, when he had made it
as fire, he said: "Bring me, that I may pour over it, molten lead

18:97.t: Thus were they made powerless to scale it or to dig through it

18:98.t: He said: "This is a mercy from my Lord: But when the promise of my Lord comes to pass, He will make it into dust; and the promise of my Lord is true

18:99.t: On that day We shall leave them to surge like waves on one another: the trumpet will be blown, and We shall collect them all together

18:100.t: And We shall present Hell that day for Unbelievers to see, all spread out

18:102.t: Do the Unbelievers think that they can take My servants as protectors besides Me? Verily We have prepared Hell for the Unbelievers for

18:103.t: Say: "Shall we tell you of those who lose most in respect of their deeds

18:104.t: Those whose efforts have been wasted in this life, while they thought that they were acquiring good by their works

18:105.t: They are those who deny the Signs of their Lord and the fact of their having to meet Him

23:44.t: Then sent We our apostles in succession: every time there came to a people their apostle, they accused him of falsehood: so We made them follow each other
: We made them as a tale
: So away with a people that will not believe

23:45.t: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron, with Our Signs and authority manifest

23:46.t: To Pharaoh and his Chiefs: But these behaved insolently: they were an arrogant people

23:47.t: They said: "Shall we believe in two men like ourselves? And their people are subject to us

23:48.t: So they accused them of falsehood, and they became of those who were destroyed

23:49.t: And We gave Moses the Book, in order that they might receive guidance

23:50.t: And We made the son of Mary and his mother as a Sign: We gave them both shelter on high ground, affording rest and security and furnished with springs

23:51.t: things good and pure, and work righteousness: for I am well-acquainted with

23:52.t: And verily this Brotherhood of yours is a single Brotherhood, and I am your Lord and Cherisher: therefore fear Me

23:53.t: But people have cut off their affair
, between them, into sects: each party rejoices in that which is with itself

23:54.t: But leave them in their confused ignorance for a time

23:55.t: Do they think that because We have granted them abundance of wealth and sons

23:56.t: We would hasten them on in every good? Nay, they do not understand

23:57.t: Verily those who live in awe for fear of their Lord

23:58.t: Those who believe in the Signs of their Lord

23:60.t: And those who dispense their charity with their hearts full of fear, because they will return to their Lord

23:61.t: It is these who hasten in every good work, and these who are foremost in them

23:62.t: On no soul do We place a burden greater than it can bear: before Us is a record which clearly shows the truth: they will never be wronged

23:63.t: But their hearts are in confused ignorance of this; and there are, besides that, deeds of theirs, which they will

23:64.t: Until, when We seize in Punishment those of them who received the good things of this world, behold, they will groan in supplication

23:65.t: : "Groan not in supplication this day: for ye shall certainly not be helped by Us

23:66.t: My Signs used to be rehearsed to you, but ye used to turn back on your heels

23:67.t: In arrogance: talking nonsense about the
, like one telling fables by night

23:68.t: Do they not ponder over the Word
come to them that did not come to their fathers of old

23:69.t: Or do they not recognise their Apostle, that they deny him

23:70.t: Or do they say, "He is possessed"? Nay, he has brought them the Truth, but most of them hate the Truth

23:71.t: If the Truth had been in accord with their desires, truly the heavens and the earth, and all beings therein would have been in confusion and corruption! Nay, We have sent them their admonition, but they turn away from their admonition

23:72.t: Or is it that thou askest them for some recompense? But the recompense of thy Lord is best: He is the Best of those who give sustenance

23:73.t: But verily thou callest them to the Straight Way

23:74.t: And verily those who believe not in the Hereafter are deviating from that Way

23:75.t: If We had mercy on them and removed the distress which is on them, they would obstinately persist in their transgression, wandering in distraction to and fro

23:76.t: We inflicted Punishment on them, but they humbled not themselves to their Lord, nor do they submissively entreat

23:77.t: Until We open on them a gate leading to a severe Punishment: then Lo! they will be plunged in despair therein

23:78.t: It is He Who has created for you
hearing, sight, feeling and understanding: little thanks it is ye give

23:79.t: And He has multiplied you through the earth, and to Him shall ye be gathered back

23:80.t: It is He Who gives life and death, and to Him
the alternation of Night and Day: will ye not then understand

23:81.t: On the contrary they say things similar to what the ancients said

23:82.t: They say: "What! when we die and become dust and bones, could we really be raised up again

23:83.t: Such things have been promised to us and to our fathers before! they are nothing but tales of the ancients

23:84.t: Say: "To whom belong the earth and all beings therein?

23:85.t: They will say, "To God!" say: "Yet will ye not receive admonition

23:86.t: Say: "Who is the Lord of the seven heavens, and the Lord of the Throne

23:87.t: to God." Say: "Will ye not then be filled with awe

23:88.t: Say: "Who is it in whose hands is the governance of all things,- who protects

23:89.t: to God." Say: "Then how are ye deluded

23:90.t: We have sent them the Truth: but they indeed practise falsehood

23:91.t: No son did God beget, nor is there any god along with Him:
, behold, each god would have taken away what he had created, and some would have lorded it over others! Glory to God!
things t hey attribute to Him

23:92.t: He knows what is hidden and what is open: too high is He for the partners they attribute to Him

23:93.t: Say: "O my Lord! if Thou wilt show me
that which they are warned against

23:94.t: Then, O my Lord! put me not amongst the people who do wrong

23:95.t: And We are certainly able to show thee
that against which they are warned

23:96.t: Repel evil with that which is best: We are well acquainted with the things they say

23:97.t: And say "O my Lord! I seek refuge with Thee from the suggestions of the Evil Ones

23:98.t: And I seek refuge with Thee O my Lord! lest they should come near me

23:99.t: Until, when death comes to one of them, he says: "O my Lord! send me back

23:100.t: In order that I may work righteousness in the things I neglected." - "By no means! It is but a word he says."- Before them is a Partition till the Day they are raised up

23:101.t: Then when the Trumpet is blown, there will be no more relationships between them that Day, nor will one ask after another

23:102.t: is heavy,- they will attain salvation

23:103.t: But those whose balance is light, will be those who have lost their souls, in Hell will they abide

23:104.t: The Fire will burn their faces, and they will therein grin, with their lips displaced

23:105.t: Were not My Signs rehearsed to you, and ye did but treat them as falsehood

23:106.t: They will say: "our Lord! Our misfortune overwhelmed us, and we became a people astray

23:107.t: Our Lord! bring us out of this: if ever we return
, then shall we be wrong-doers indeed

23:108.t: He will say: "Be ye driven into it
! And speak ye not to Me

23:109.t: A part of My servants there was, who used to pray 'our Lord! we believe; then do Thou forgive us, and have mercy upon us: For Thou art the Best of those who show mercy

23:110.t: But ye treated them with ridicule, so much so that
them made you forget My Message while ye were laughing at them

23:111.t: I have rewarded them this Day for their patience and constancy: they are indeed the ones that have achieved Bliss

23:112.t: He will say: "What number of years did ye stay on earth

23:113.t: They will say: "We stayed a day or part of a day: but ask those who keep account

23:114.t: He will say: "Ye stayed not but a little,- if ye had only known

23:115.t: Did ye then think that We had created you in jest, and that ye would not be brought back to Us

23:116.t: Therefore exalted be God, the King, the Reality: there is no god but He, the Lord of the Throne of Honour

23:117.t: If anyone invokes, besides God, Any other god, he has no authority therefor; and his reckoning will be only with his Lord! and verily the Unbelievers will fail to win through

23:118.t: So say: "O my Lord! grant Thou forgiveness and mercy for Thou art the Best of those who show mercy

24:1.t: A sura which We have sent down and which We have ordained in it have We sent down Clear Signs, in order that ye may receive admonition

24:2.t: The woman and the man guilty of adultery or fornication,- flog each of them with a hundred stripes: Let not compassion move you in their case, in a matter prescribed by God, if ye believe in God and the Last Day: and let a party of the Believe rs witness their punishment

24:3.t: Let no man guilty of adultery or fornication marry and but a woman similarly guilty, or an Unbeliever: nor let any but such a man or an Unbeliever marry such a woman: to the Believers such a thing is forbidden

24:4.t: And those who launch a charge against chaste women, and produce not four witnesses
,- flog them with eighty stripes; and reject their evidence ever after: for such men are wicked transgressors

24:5.t: Unless they repent thereafter and mend
; for God is Oft- Forgiving, Most Merciful

24:6.t: And for those who launch a charge against their spouses, and have
no evidence but their own,- their solitary evidence
if they bear witness four times
by God that they are solemnly telling the truth

24:7.t: that they solemnly invoke the curse of God on themselves if they tell a lie

24:8.t: But it would avert the punishment from the wife, if she bears witness four times

24:9.t: should be that she solemnly invokes the wrath of God on herself if

24:10.t: If it were not for God's grace and mercy on you, and that God is Oft- Returning, full of Wisdom,-

24:11.t: Those who brought forward the lie are a body among yourselves: think it not to be an evil to you; On the contrary it is good for you: to every man among them
of the sin that he earned, and to him who took on himself the lead among them, will be a penalty grievous

24:12.t: Why did not the believers - men and women - when ye heard of the affair,- put the best construction on it in their own minds and say, "This

24:13.t: Why did they not bring four witnesses to prove it? When they have not brought the witnesses, such men, in the sight of God,

24:14.t: Were it not for the grace and mercy of God on you, in this world and the Hereafter, a grievous penalty would have seized you in that ye rushed glibly into this affair

24:15.t: Behold, ye received it on your tongues, and said out of your mouths things of which ye had no knowledge; and ye thought it to be a light matter, while it was most serious in the sight of God

24:16.t: And why did ye not, when ye heard it, say? - "It is not right of us to speak of this: Glory to God! this is a most serious slander

24:17.t: God doth admonish you, that ye may never repeat such

24:18.t: And God makes the Signs plain to you: for God is full of knowledge and wisdom

24:19.t: scandal published broadcast among the Believers, will have a grievous Penalty in this life and in the Hereafter: God knows, and ye know not

24:20.t: Were it not for the grace and mercy of God on you, and that God is full of kindness and mercy,

24:21.t: O ye who believe! follow not Satan's footsteps: if any will follow the footsteps of Satan, he will

command what is shameful and wrong: and were it not for the grace and mercy of God on you, not one of you would ever have been pure: but G od doth purify whom He pleases: and God is One Who hears and knows

24:22.t: Let not those among you who are endued with grace and amplitude of means resolve by oath against helping their kinsmen, those in want, and those who have left their homes in God's cause: let them forgive and overlook, do you not wish that God should forgive you? For God is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful

24:23.t: Those who slander chaste women, indiscreet but believing, are cursed in this life and in the Hereafter: for them is a grievous Penalty

24:24.t: On the Day when their tongues, their hands, and their feet will bear witness against them as to their actions

24:25.t: On that Day God will pay them back
their just dues, and they will realise that God is the
Truth, that makes all things manifest

24:26.t: Women impure are for men impure, and men impure for women impure and women of purity are for men of purity, and men of purity are for women of purity: these are not affected by what people say: for them there is forgiveness, and a provision ho nourable

24:27.t: O ye who believe! enter not houses other than your own, until ye have asked permission and saluted those in them: that is best for you, in order that ye may heed

24:28.t: If ye find no one in the house, enter not until permission is given to you: if ye are asked to go back, go back: that makes for greater purity for yourselves: and God knows well all that ye do

24:29.t: It is no fault on your part to enter houses not used for living in, which serve some
use for you: And God has knowledge of what ye reveal and what ye conceal

24:30.t: Say to the believing men that they should lower their gaze and guard their modesty: that will make for greater purity for them: And God is well acquainted with all that they do

24:31.t: And say to the believing women that they should lower their gaze and guard their modesty; that they should not display their beauty and ornaments except what

appear thereof; that they should draw their veils over their bosoms and not display their beauty except to their husbands, their fathers, their husband's fathers, their sons, their husbands' sons, their brothers or their brothers' sons, or their sisters' sons, or their women, or the slaves whom their right hands posses s, or male servants free of physical needs, or small children who have no sense of the shame of sex; and that they should not strike their feet in order to draw attention to their hidden ornaments. And O ye Believers! turn ye all together towards God, that ye may attain Bliss

24:32.t: Marry those among you who are single, or the virtuous ones among yourselves, male or female: if they are in poverty, God will give them means out of His grace: for God encompasseth all, and he knoweth all things

24:33.t: Let those who find not the wherewithal for marriage keep themselves chaste, until God gives them means out of His grace. And if any of your slaves ask for a deed in writing
to enable them to earn their freedom for a certain sum

, give them suc h a deed if ye know any good in them: yea, give them something yourselves out of the means which God has given to you. But force not your maids to prostitution when they desire chastity, in order that ye may make a gain in the goods of this life. But if anyone compels them, yet, after such compulsion, is God, Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful

24:34.t: We have already sent down to you verses making things clear, an illustration from
people who passed away before you, and an admonition for those who fear

24:35.t: God is the Light of the heavens and the earth. The Parable of His Light is as if there were a Niche and within it a Lamp: the Lamp enclosed in Glass: the glass as it were a brilliant star: Lit from a blessed Tree, an Olive, neither of the east nor of the west, whose oil is well-nigh luminous, though fire scarce touched it: Light upon Light! God doth guide whom He will to His Light: God doth set forth Parables for men: and God doth know all things

24:36.t: in houses, which God hath permitted to be raised to honour; for the celebration, in them, of His name: In them is He glorified in the mornings and in the evenings,

24:37.t: By men whom neither traffic nor merchandise can divert from the Remembrance of God, nor from regular Prayer, nor from the practice of regular Charity: Their
fear is for the Day when hearts and eyes will be transformed

24:38.t: That God may reward them according to the best of their deeds, and add even more for them out of His Grace: for God doth provide for those whom He will, without measure

24:39.t: But the Unbelievers,- their deeds are like a mirage in sandy deserts, which the man parched with thirst mistakes for water; until when he comes up to it, he finds it to be nothing: But he finds God
with him, and God will pay him his acco unt: and God is swift in taking account

24:40.t: is like the depths of darkness in a vast deep ocean, overwhelmed with billow topped by billow, topped by
clouds: depths of darkness, one above another: if a man stretches out his hands, he can hardly see it! f or any to whom God giveth not light, there is no light

24:41.t: Seest thou not that it is God Whose praises all beings in the heavens and on earth do celebrate, and the birds
with wings outspread? Each one knows its own
prayer and praise. And God knows well all that they do

24:42.t: Yea, to God belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; and to God is the final goal

24:43.t: Seest thou not that God makes the clouds move gently, then joins them together, then makes them into a heap? - then wilt thou see rain issue forth from their midst. And He sends down from the sky mountain masses
wherein is hail: He strikes therewith whom He pleases and He turns it away from whom He pleases, the vivid flash of His lightning well-nigh blinds the sight

24:44.t: It is God Who alternates the Night and the Day: verily in these things is an instructive example for those who have vision

24:45.t: And God has created every animal from water: of them there are some that creep on their bellies; some that walk on two legs; and some that walk on four. God creates what He wills for verily God has power over all things

24:46.t: We have indeed sent down signs that make things manifest: and God guides whom He wills to a way that is straight

24:47.t: They say, "We believe in God and in the apostle, and we obey": but even after that, some of them turn away: they are not

24:48.t: When they are summoned to God and His apostle, in order that He may judge between them, behold some of them decline

24:49.t: But if the right is on their side, they come to him with all submission

24:50.t: Is it that there is a disease in their hearts? or do they doubt, or are they in fear, that God and His Apostle will deal unjustly with them? Nay, it is they themselves who do wrong

24:51.t: The answer of the Believers, when summoned to God and His Apostle, in order that He may judge between them, is no other than this: they say, "We hear and we obey": it is such as these that will attain felicity

24:52.t: It is such as obey God and His Apostle, and fear God and do right, that will win

24:53.t: They swear their strongest oaths by God that, if only thou wouldst command them, they would leave
reasonable; verily, God is well acquainted with all that ye do

24:54.t: Say: "Obey God, and obey the Apostle: but if ye turn away, he is only responsible for the duty placed on him and ye for that placed on you. If ye obey him, ye shall be on right guidance. The Apostle's duty is only to preach the clear

24:55.t: God has promised, to those among you who believe and work righteous deeds, that He will, of a surety, grant them in the land, inheritance
, as He granted it to those before them; that He will establish in authority their religion - th e one which He has chosen for them; and that He will change
, after the fear in which they
, to one of security and peace: 'They will worship Me
and not associate aught with Me. 'If any do reject Faith after this, they are r ebellious and wicked

24:56.t: So establish regular Prayer and give regular Charity; and obey the Apostle; that ye may receive mercy

24:57.t: Never think thou that the Unbelievers are going to frustrate
on earth: their abode is the Fire,- and it is indeed an evil refuge

24:58.t: O ye who believe! let those whom your right hands possess, and the
among you who have not come of age ask your permission
before they come to your presence

, on three occasions: before morning prayer; the while ye doff your clothes for the noonday heat; and after the late-night prayer: these are your three times of undress: outside those times it is not wrong for you or for them to move about attending to each other: Thus does God make clear the Signs to you: for God is full of knowledge and wisdom

24:59.t: But when the children among you come of age, let them
ask for permission, as do those senior to them
: Thus does God make clear His Signs to you: for God is full of knowledge and wisdom

24:60.t: Such elderly women as are past the prospect of marriage,- there is no blame on them if they lay aside their
garments, provided they make not a wanton display of their beauty: but it is best for them to be modest: and God is One Who sees and knows all things

24:61.t: It is no fault in the blind nor in one born lame, nor in one afflicted with illness, nor in yourselves, that ye should eat in your own houses, or those of your fathers, or your mothers, or your brothers, or your sisters, or your father's brothe rs or your father's sisters, or your mohter's brothers, or your mother's sisters, or in houses of which the keys are in your possession, or in the house of a sincere friend of yours: there is no blame on you, whether ye eat in company or separately. Bu t if ye enter houses, salute each other - a greeting of blessing and purity as from God. Thus does God make clear the signs to you: that ye may understand

24:62.t: Only those are believers, who believe in God and His Apostle: when they are with him on a matter requiring collective action, they do not depart until they have asked for his leave; those who ask for thy leave are those who believe in God and H is Apostle; so when they ask for thy leave, for some business of theirs, give leave to those of them whom thou wilt, and ask God for their forgiveness: for God is Oft- Forgiving, Most Merciful

24:63.t: Deem not the summons of the Apostle among yourselves like the summons of one of you to another: God doth know those of you who slip away under shelter of some excuse: then let those beware who withstand the Apostle's order, lest some trial bef all them, or a grievous penalty be inflicted on them

24:64.t: Be quite sure that to God doth belong whatever is in the heavens and on earth. Well doth He know what ye are intent upon: and one day they will be brought back to Him, and He will tell them the truth of what they did: for God doth know all thi ngs

25:1.t: Blessed is He who sent down the criterion to His servant, that it may be an admonition to all creatures

25:2.t: He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth: no son has He begotten, nor has He a partner in His dominion: it is He who created all things, and ordered them in due proportions

25:3.t: Yet have they taken, besides him, gods that can create nothing but are themselves created; that have no control of hurt or good to themselves; nor can they control death nor life nor resurrection

25:4.t: But the misbelievers say: "Naught is this but a lie which he has forged, and others have helped him at it." In truth it is they who have put forward an iniquity and a falsehood

25:5.t: And they say: "Tales of the ancients, which he has caused to be written: and they are dictated before him morning and evening

25:6.t: was sent down by Him who knows the mystery
in the heavens and the earth: verily He is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful

25:7.t: And they say: "What sort of an apostle is this, who eats food, and walks through the streets? Why has not an angel been sent down to him to give admonition with him

25:8.t: has not a treasure been bestowed on him, or why has he
a garden for enjoyment?" The wicked say: "Ye follow none other than a man bewitched

25:9.t: See what kinds of comparisons they make for thee! But they have gone astray, and never a way will they be able to find

25:10.t: Blessed is He who, if that were His will, could give thee better
than those,- Gardens beneath which rivers flow; and He could give thee palaces

25:11.t: : but We have prepared a blazing fire for such as deny the hour

25:12.t: When it sees them from a place fAr off, they will hear its fury and its ranging sigh

25:13.t: And when they are cast, bound together into a constricted place therein, they will pLead for destruction there and then

25:14.t: This day plead not for a single destruction: plead for destruction oft- repeated

25:15.t: Say: "Is that best, or the eternal garden, promised to the righteous? for them, that is a reward as well as a goal

25:16.t: For them there will be therein all that they wish for: they will dwell
for aye: A promise to be prayed for from thy Lord

25:17.t: The day He will gather them together as well as those whom they worship besides God, He will ask: "Was it ye who let these My servants astray, or did they stray from the Path themselves

25:18.t: They will say: "Glory to Thee! not meet was it for us that we should take for protectors others besides Thee: But Thou didst bestow, on them and their fathers, good things
, until they forgot the Message: for they were a people

25:19.t: : "Now have they proved you liars in what ye say: so ye cannot avert
help." And whoever among you does wrong, him shall We cause to taste of a grievous Penalty

25:20.t: And the apostles whom We sent before thee were all
who ate food and walked through the streets: We have made some of you as a trial for others: will ye have patience? for God is One Who sees

25:21.t: Such as fear not the meeting with Us
say: "Why are not the angels sent down to us, or
do we not see our Lord?" Indeed they have an arrogant conceit of themselves, and mighty is the insolence of their impiety

25:22.t: The Day they see the angels,- no joy will there be to the sinners that Day: The
will say: "There is a barrier forbidden

25:23.t: And We shall turn to whatever deeds they did
, and We shall make such deeds as floating dust scattered about

25:24.t: The Companions of the Garden will be well, that Day, in their abode, and have the fairest of places for repose

25:25.t: The Day the heaven shall be rent asunder with clouds, and angels shall be sent down, descending

25:26.t: That Day, the dominion as of right and truth, shall be
Most Merciful: it will be a Day of dire difficulty for the Misbelievers

25:27.t: The Day that the wrong-doer will bite at his hands, he will say, "Oh! would that I had taken a

25:28.t: Ah! woe is me! Would that I had never taken such a one for a friend

25:29.t: He did lead me astray from the Message
after it had come to me! Ah! the Evil One is but a traitor to man!" Then the Apostle will say

25:30.t: O my Lord! Truly my people took this Qur'an for just foolish nonsense

25:31.t: Thus have We made for every prophet an enemy among the sinners: but enough is thy Lord to guide and to help

25:32.t: Those who reject Faith say: "Why is not the Qur'an revealed to him all at once? Thus
, that We may strengthen thy heart thereby, and We have rehearsed it to thee in slow, well-arranged stages, gradually

25:33.t: And no question do they bring to thee but We reveal to thee the truth and the best explanation

25:34.t: Those who will be gathered to Hell
on their faces,- they will be in an evil plight, and, as to Path, most astray

25:35.t: We sent Moses The Book, and appointed his brother Aaron with him as minister

25:36.t: And We command: "Go ye both, to the people who have rejected our Signs:" And those

25:37.t: And the people of Noah,- when they rejected the apostles, We drowned them, and We made them as a Sign for mankind; and We have prepared for

25:38.t: As also 'Ad and Thamud, and the Companions of the Rass, and many a generation between them

25:39.t: To each one We set forth Parables and examples; and each one We broke to utter annihilation

25:40.t: must indeed have passed by the town on which was rained a shower of evil: did they not then see it
? But they fear not the Resurrection

25:41.t: When they see thee, they treat thee no otherwise than in mockery: "Is this the one whom God has sent as an apostle

25:42.t: He indeed would well-nigh have misled us from our gods, had it not been that we were constant to them!" - Soon will they know, when they see the Penalty, who it is that is most misled in Path

25:43.t: Seest thou such a one as taketh for his god his own passion
? Couldst thou be a disposer of affairs for him

25:44.t: Or thinkest thou that most of them listen or understand? They are only like cattle;- nay, they are worse astray in Path

25:45.t: Hast thou not turned thy vision to thy Lord?- How He doth prolong the shadow! If He willed, He could make it stationary! then do We make the sun its guide

25:46.t: Then We draw it in towards Ourselves,- a contraction by easy stages

25:47.t: And He it is Who makes the Night as a Robe for you, and Sleep as Repose, and makes the Day

25:48.t: And He it is Who sends the winds as heralds of glad tidings, going before His mercy, and We send down pure water from the sky

25:49.t: That with it We may give life to a dead land, and slake the thirst of things We have created,- cattle and men in great numbers

25:50.t: amongst them, in order that they may celebrate
praises, but most men are averse

25:51.t: Had it been Our Will, We could have sent a warner to every centre of population

25:52.t: Therefore listen not to the Unbelievers, but strive against them with the utmost strenuousness, with the

25:53.t: It is He Who has let free the two bodies of flowing water: One palatable and sweet, and the other salt and bitter; yet has He made a barrier between them, a partition that is forbidden to be passed

25:54.t: It is He Who has created man from water: then has He established relationships of lineage and marriage: for thy Lord has power

25:55.t: Yet do they worship, besides God, things that can neither profit them nor harm them: and the Misbeliever is a helper

25:56.t: But thee We only sent to give glad tidings and admonition

25:57.t: Say: "No reward do I ask of you for it but this: that each one who will may take a

35:1.t: Praise be to God, Who created
the heavens and the earth, Who made the angels, messengers with wings,- two, or three, or four
: He adds to Creation as He pleases: for God has power over all things

35:2.t: What God out of his Mercy doth bestow on mankind there is none can withhold: what He doth withhold, there is none can grant, apart from Him: and He is the Exalted in Power, full of Wisdom

35:3.t: O men! Call to mind the grace of God unto you! is there a creator, other than God, to give you sustenance from heaven or earth? There is no god but He: how then are ye deluded away from the Truth

35:4.t: And if they reject thee, so were apostles rejected before thee: to God back for decision all affairs

35:5.t: O men! Certainly the promise of God is true. Let not then this present life deceive you, nor let the Chief Deceiver deceive you about God

35:6.t: Verily Satan is an enemy to you: so treat him as an enemy. He only invites his adherents, that they may become Companions of the Blazing Fire

35:7.t: For those who reject God, is a terrible Penalty: but for those who believe and work righteous deeds, is Forgiveness, and a magnificent Reward

35:8.t: Is he, then, to whom the evil of his conduct is made alluring, so that he looks upon it as good,
equal to one who is rightly guided
? For God leaves to stray whom He wills, and guides whom He wills. So let not thy soul go out in
sighi ng after them: for God knows well all that they do

Words of Purity: It is He Who exalts each Deed of Righteousness. Those that lay Plots of Evil,- for them is a Penalty terrible; and the plotting of su ch will be void

58:15.t: God has prepared for them a severe Penalty: evil indeed are their deeds

58:16.t: They have made their oaths a screen
from the Path of God: therefore shall they have a humiliating Penalty

58:17.t: Of no profit whatever to them, against God, will be their riches nor their sons: they will be Companions of the Fire, to dwell therein

58:18.t: One day will God raise them all up
: then will they swear to Him as they swear to you: And they think that they have something
. No, indeed! they are but liars

58:19.t: The Evil One has got the better of them: so he has made them lose the remembrance of God. They are the Party of the Evil One. Truly, it is the Party of the Evil One that will perish

58:20.t: Those who resist God and His Apostle will be among those most humiliated

58:21.t: God has decreed: "It is I and My apostles who must prevail": For God is One full of strength, able to enforce His Will

58:22.t: Thou wilt not find any people who believe in God and the Last Day, loving those who resist God and His Apostle, even though they were their fathers or their sons, or their brothers, or their kindred. For such He has written Faith in their heart s, and strengthened them with a spirit from Himself. And He will admit them to Gardens beneath which Rivers flow, to dwell therein
. God will be well pleased with them, and they with Him. They are the Party of God. Truly it is the Party of God that will achieve Felicity

59:1.t: Whatever is in the heavens and on earth, let it declare the Praises and Glory of God: for He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

59:2.t: It is He Who got out the Unbelievers among the People of the Book from their homes at the first gathering
. Little did ye think that they would get out: And they thought that their fortresses would defend them from God! But the
God came to them from quarters from which they little expected
, and cast terror into their hearts, so that they destroyed their dwellings by their own hands and the hands of the Believers, take warning, then, O ye with eyes

59:3.t: And had it not been that God had decreed banishment for them, He would certainly have punished them in this world: And in the Hereafter they shall
have the Punishment of the Fire

59:4.t: That is because they resisted God and His Apostle: and if any one resists God, verily God is severe in Punishment

59:5.t: The tender palm-trees, or ye left them standing on their roots, it was by leave of God, and in order that He might cover with shame the rebellious transgresses

59:6.t: What God has bestowed on His Apostle
from them - for this ye made no expedition with either cavalry or camelry: but God gives power to His apostles over any He pleases: and God has power over all things

59:7.t: What God has bestowed on His Apostle
from the people of the townships,- belongs to God,- to His Apostle and to kindred and orphans, the needy and the wayfarer; In order that it may not
make a circuit between the wealt hy among you. So take what the Apostle assigns to you, and deny yourselves that which he withholds from you. And fear God; for God is strict in Punishment

59:8.t: to the indigent Muhajirs, those who were expelled from their homes and their property, while seeking Grace from God and
Good Pleasure, and aiding God and His Apostle: such are indeed the sincere ones

59:9.t: But those who before them, had homes
and had adopted the Faith,- show their affection to such as came to them for refuge, and entertain no desire in their hearts for things given to the
, but give them preference over thems elves, even though poverty was their
. And those saved from the covetousness of their own souls,- they are the ones that achieve prosperity

59:10.t: And those who came after them say: "Our Lord! Forgive us, and our brethren who came before us into the Faith, and leave not, in our hearts, rancour
against those who have believed. Our Lord! Thou art indeed Full of Kindnes s, Most Merciful

59:11.t: Hast thou not observed the Hypocrites say to their misbelieving brethren among the People of the Book? - "If ye are expelled, we too will go out with you, and we will never hearken to any one in your affair; and if ye are attacked
we will help you". But God is witness that they are indeed liars

59:12.t: If they are expelled, never will they go out with them; and if they are attacked
, they will never help them; and if they do help them, they will turn their backs; so they will receive no help

59:13.t: Of a truth ye are stronger
because of the terror in their hearts,
by God. This is because they are men devoid of understanding

59:14.t: together, except in fortified townships, or from behind walls. Strong is their fighting
amongst themselves: thou wouldst think they were united, but their hearts are divided: that is because they are a pe ople devoid of wisdom

59:15.t: Like those who lately preceded them, they have tasted the evil result of their conduct; and

59:16.t: , like the Evil One, when he says to man, "Deny God": but when
says, "I am free of thee: I do fear God, the Lord of the Worlds

59:17.t: The end of both will be that they will go into the Fire, dwelling therein for ever. Such is the reward of the wrong-doers

59:18.t: O ye who believe! Fear God, and let every soul look to what
He has sent forth for the morrow. Yea, fear God: for God is well-acquainted with

59:19.t: And be ye not like those who forgot God; and He made them forget their own souls! Such are the rebellious transgressors

59:20.t: Not equal are the Companions of the Fire and the Companions of the Garden: it is the Companions of the Garden, that will achieve Felicity

59:21.t: Had We sent down this Qur'an on a mountain, verily, thou wouldst have seen it humble itself and cleave asunder for fear of God. Such are the similitudes which We propound to men, that they may reflect

59:22.t: God is He, than Whom there is no other god;- Who knows
both secret and open; He, Most Gracious, Most Merciful

59:23.t: God is He, than Whom there is no other god;- the Sovereign, the Holy One, the Source of Peace
, the Guardian of Faith, the Preserver of Safety, the Exalted in Might, the Irresistible, the Supreme: Glory to God!
ab ove the partners they attribute to Him

59:24.t: He is God, the Creator, the Evolver, the Bestower of Forms
. To Him belong the Most Beautiful Names: whatever is in the heavens and on earth, doth declare His Praises and Glory: and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

60:1.t: O ye who believe! Take not my enemies and yours as friends
love, even though they have rejected the Truth that has come to you, and have
driven out the Prophet and yourselves
because ye believe in God your Lord! If ye have come out to strive in My Way and to seek My Good Pleasure,
with them: for I know full well all that ye conceal and all that ye reveal. And any of you that does this has strayed from the Straight Path

60:2.t: If they were to get the better of you, they would behave to you as enemies, and stretch forth their hands and their tongues against you for evil: and they desire that ye should reject the Truth

60:3.t: Of no profit to you will be your relatives and your children on the Day of Judgment: He will judge between you: for God sees well all that ye do

60:4.t: There is for you an excellent example

in Abraham and those with him, when they said to their people: "We are clear of you and of whatever ye worship besides God: we have rejected you, and there has arisen, between us and you, enmity and hatred for ever,- unless ye believe in God and Him alone": But not when Abraham said to his father: "I will pray for forgiveness for thee, though I have no power
aught on thy behalf from God."
: "Our Lord! in Thee do we trus t, and to Thee do we turn in repentance: to Thee is

60:5.t: Our Lord! Make us not a
trial for the Unbelievers, but forgive us, our Lord! for Thou art the Exalted in Might, the Wise

60:6.t: There was indeed in them an excellent example for you to follow,- for those whose hope is in God and in the Last Day. But if any turn away, truly God is Free of all Wants, Worthy of all Praise

60:7.t: It may be that God will grant love
between you and those whom ye
hold as enemies. For God has power
; And God is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful

60:8.t: God forbids you not, with regard to those who fight you not for
Faith nor drive you out of your homes, from dealing kindly and justly with them: for God loveth those who are just

60:9.t: God only forbids you, with regard to those who fight you for
Faith, and drive you out of your homes, and support
in driving you out, from turning to them
. It is such as turn to them

60:10.t: O ye who believe! When there come to you believing women refugees, examine
them: God knows best as to their Faith: if ye ascertain that they are Believers, then send them not back to the Unbelievers. They are not lawful
for the Unbelievers, nor are the
for them. But pay the Unbelievers what they have spent
, and there will be no blame on you if ye marry them on payment of their dower to them. But hold not to the guardianshi p of unbelieving women: ask for what ye have spent on their dowers, and let the
ask for what they have spent
on the dowers of women who come over to you
. Such is the command of God: He judges
between you. And God is Full of Knowledge and Wisdom

60:11.t: And if any of your wives deserts you to the Unbelievers, and ye have an accession
by the coming over of a woman from the other side
, then pay to those whose wives have deserted the equivalent of what they had spent
. And fear God, in Whom ye believe

60:12.t: O Prophet! When believing women come to thee to take the oath of fealty to thee, that they will not associate in worship any other thing whatever with God, that they will not steal, that they will not commit adultery

, that they will not kill their children, that they will not utter slander, intentionally forging falsehood, and that they will not disobey thee in any just matter,- then do thou receive their fealty, and pray to God for the forgiveness
: for God i s Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful

60:13.t: O ye who believe! Turn not
to people on whom is the Wrath of God, of the Hereafter they are already in despair, just as the Unbelievers are in despair about those

61:1.t: Whatever is in the heavens and on earth, let it declare the Praises and Glory of God: for He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise

61:2.t: O ye who believe! Why say ye that which ye do not

61:3.t: Grievously odious is it in the sight of God that ye say that which ye do not

61:4.t: Truly God loves those who fight in His Cause in battle array, as if they were a solid cemented structure

61:5.t: And remember, Moses said to his people: "O my people! why do ye vex and insult me, though ye know that I am the apostle of God
to you?" Then when they went wrong, God let their hearts go wrong. For God guides not those who are rebellio us transgressors

61:6.t: And remember, Jesus, the son of Mary, said: "O Children of Israel! I am the apostle of God
before me, and giving Glad Tidings of an Apostle to come after me, whose name shall be Ahmad." But when h e came to them with Clear Signs, they said, "this is evident sorcery

61:7.t: Who doth greater wrong than one who invents falsehood against God, even as he is being invited to Islam? And God guides not those who do wrong

61:8.t: Their intention is to extinguish God's Light
with their mouths: But God will complete
His Light, even though the Unbelievers may detest

61:9.t: It is He Who has sent His Apostle with Guidance and the Religion of Truth, that he may proclaim it over all religion, even though the Pagans may detest

61:10.t: O ye who believe! Shall I lead you to a bargain that will save you from a grievous Penalty

61:11.t: That ye believe in God and His Apostle, and that ye strive
in the Cause of God, with your property and your persons: That will be best for you, if ye but knew

61:12.t: He will forgive you your sins, and admit you to Gardens beneath which Rivers flow, and to beautiful mansions in Gardens of Eternity: that is indeed the Supreme Achievement

61:13.t: which ye do love,- help from God and a speedy victory. So give the Glad Tidings to the Believers

61:14.t: O ye who believe! Be ye helpers of God: As said Jesus the son of Mary to the Disciples, "Who will be my helpers to

God?" Said the disciples, "We are God's helpers!" then a portion of the Children of Israel believed, and a portion disbelieved: But We gave power to those who believed, against their enemies, and they became the ones that prevailed

62:1.t: Whatever is in the heavens and on earth, doth declare the Praises and Glory of God,- the Sovereign, the Holy One, the Exalted in Might, the Wise

62:2.t: It is He Who has sent amongst the Unlettered an apostle from among themselves, to rehearse to them His Signs, to sanctify them, and to instruct them in Scripture and Wisdom,- although they had been, before, in manifest error

62:3.t: to confer all these benefits upon
others of them, who have not already joined them: And He is exalted in Might, Wise

62:4.t: Such is the Bounty of God, which He bestows on whom He will: and God is the Lord of the highest bounty

62:5.t: The similitude of those who were charged with the
Mosaic Law, but who subsequently failed in those
, is that of a donkey which carries huge tomes
. Evil is the similitude of people wh o falsify the Signs of God: and God guides not people who do wrong

62:6.t: Say: "O ye that stand on Judaism! If ye think that ye are friends to God, to the exclusion of
men, then express your desire for Death, if ye are truthful

62:7.t: But never will they express their desire
their hands have sent on before them! and God knows well those that do wrong

62:8.t: Say: "The Death from which ye flee will truly overtake you: then will ye be sent back to the Knower of things secret and open: and He will tell you

62:9.t: O ye who believe! When the call is proclaimed to prayer on Friday
, hasten earnestly to the Remembrance of God, and leave off business
: That is best for you if ye but knew

62:10.t: And when the Prayer is finished, then may ye disperse through the land, and seek of the Bounty of God: and celebrate the Praises of God often

62:11.t: But when they see some bargain or some amusement, they disperse headlong to it, and leave thee standing. Say: "The
from the Presence of God is better than any amusement or bargain! and God is the Best to provide

63:1.t: When the Hypocrites come to thee, they say, "We bear witness that thou art indeed the Apostle of God." Yea, God knoweth that thou art indeed His Apostle, and God beareth witness that the Hypocrites are indeed liars

63:2.t: They have made their oaths a screen
from the Path of God: truly evil are their deeds

63:3.t: That is because they believed, then they rejected Faith: So a seal was set on their hearts: therefore they understand not

63:4.t: When thou lookest at them, their exteriors please thee; and when they speak, thou listenest to their words. They are as
unable to stand on their own
. They think that every cry is against them. They are the enemies; so beware of them. The curse of God be on them! How are they deluded

63:5.t: And when it is said to them, "Come, the Apostle of God will pray for your forgiveness", they turn aside their heads, and thou wouldst see them turning away their faces in arrogance

63:6.t: It is equal to them whether thou pray for their forgiveness or not. God will not forgive them. Truly God guides not rebellious transgressors

63:7.t: They are the ones who say, "Spend nothing on those who are with God's Apostle, to the end that they may disperse
." But to God belong the treasures of the heavens and the earth; but the Hypocrites understand not

63:8.t: They say, "If we return to Medina, surely the more honourable
will expel therefrom the meaner." But honour belongs to God and His Apostle, and to the Believers; but the Hypocrites know not

63:9.t: O ye who believe! Let not your riches or your children divert you from the remembrance of God. If any act thus, the loss is their own

63:10.t: out of the substance which We have bestowed on you, before Death should come to any of you and he should say, "O my Lord! why didst Thou not give me respite for a little while? I should then have given
in charity, and I should have been one of the doers of good

63:11.t: But to no soul will God grant respite when the time appointed
has come; and God is well acquainted with

64:1.t: Whatever is in the heavens and on earth, doth declare the Praises and Glory of God: to Him belongs dominion, and to Him belongs praise: and He has power over all things

64:2.t: It is He Who has created you; and of you are some that are Unbelievers, and some that are Believers: and God sees well all that ye do

64:3.t: He has created the heavens and the earth in just proportions, and has given you shape, and made your shapes beautiful: and to Him is the final Goal

64:4.t: He knows what is in the heavens and on earth; and He knows what ye conceal and what ye reveal: yea, God knows well the

64:5.t: Has not the story reached you, of those who rejected Faith aforetime? So they tasted the evil result of their conduct; and they had a grievous Penalty

64:6.t: That was because there came to them apostles with Clear Signs, but they said: "Shall
human beings direct us?" So they rejected
and turned away. But God can do without
: and God is free of all needs, worthy of all pra ise

64:7.t: The Unbelievers think that they will not be raised up
. Say: "Yea, By my Lord, Ye shall surely be raised up: then shall ye be told
of all that ye did. And that is easy for God

64:8.t: Believe, therefore, in God and His Apostle, and in the Light which we have sent down. And God is well acquainted with all that ye do

64:9.t: The Day that He assembles you
for a Day of Assembly,- that will be a Day of mutual loss and gain

, and those who believe in God and work righteousness,- He will remove from them their ills, and He will admit them to Gardens be neath which Rivers flow, to dwell therein for ever: that will be the Supreme Achievement

64:10.t: But those who reject Faith and treat Our Signs as falsehoods, they will be Companions of the Fire, to dwell therein for aye: and evil is that Goal

64:11.t: No kind of calamity can occur, except by the leave of God: and if any one believes in God,

64:12.t: So obey God, and obey His Apostle: but if ye turn back, the duty of Our Apostle is but to proclaim

64:13.t: God! There is no god but He: and on God, therefore, let the Believers put their trust

64:14.t: O ye who believe! Truly, among your wives and your children are
enemies to yourselves: so beware of them! But if ye forgive and overlook, and cover up
, verily God is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful

64:15.t: Your riches and your children may be but a trial: but in the Presence of God, is the highest, Reward

64:16.t: So fear God as much as ye can; listen and obey and spend in charity for the benefit of your own soul and those saved from the covetousness of their own souls,- they are the ones that achieve prosperity

64:17.t: If ye loan to God, a beautiful loan, He will double it to your
, and He will grant you Forgiveness: for God is most Ready to appreciate

64:18.t: Knower of what is open, Exalted in Might, Full of Wisdom

65:1.t: O Prophet! When ye do divorce women, divorce them at their prescribed periods, and count
, their prescribed periods: And fear God your Lord: and turn them not out of their houses, nor shall they
leave, except in case t hey are guilty of some open lewdness, those are limits set by God: and any who transgresses the limits of God, does verily wrong his
soul: thou knowest not if perchance God will bring about thereafter some new situation

65:2.t: Thus when they fulfil their term appointed, either take them back on equitable terms or part with them on equitable terms; and take for witness two persons from among you, endued with justice, and establish the evidence
before God. Such i s the admonition given to him who believes in God and the Last Day. And for those who fear God, He

65:3.t: And He provides for him from
he never could imagine. And if any one puts his trust in God, sufficient is
for him. For God will surely accomplish his purpose: verily, for all things has God appointed a due proportion

65:4.t: Such of your women as have passed the age of monthly courses, for them the prescribed period, if ye have any doubts, is three months, and for those who have no courses
, their perio d is until they deliver their burdens: and for those who fear God, He will make their path easy

65:5.t: That is the Command of God, which He has sent down to you: and if any one fears God, He will remove his ills, from him, and will enlarge his reward

65:6.t: in the same style as ye live, according to your means: Annoy them not, so as to restrict them. And if they carry
on them until they deliver their burden: and if t hey suckle your
, give them their recompense: and take mutual counsel together, according to what is just and reasonable. And if ye find yourselves in difficulties, let another woman suckle

65:7.t: Let the man of means spend according to his means: and the man whose resources are restricted, let him spend according to what God has given him. God puts no burden on any person beyond what He has given him. After a difficulty, God will soon grant relief

65:8.t: How many populations that insolently opposed the Command of their Lord and of His apostles, did We not then call to account,- to severe account?- and We imposed on them an exemplary Punishment

65:9.t: Then did they taste the evil result of their conduct, and the End of their conduct was Perdition

65:10.t: God has prepared for them a severe Punishment
. Therefore fear God, O ye men of understanding - who have believed!- for God hath indeed sent down to you a Message

65:11.t: An Apostle, who rehearses to you the Signs of God containing clear explanations, that he may lead forth those who believe and do righteous deeds from the depths of Darkness into Light. And those who believe in God and work righteousness, He wi ll admit to Gardens beneath which Rivers flow, to dwell therein for ever: God has indeed granted for them a most excellent Provision

65:12.t: God is He Who created seven Firmaments and of the earth a similar number. Through the midst of them
descends His Command: that ye may know that God has power over all things, and that God comprehends, all things in

66:1.t: O Prophet! Why holdest thou to be forbidden that which God has made lawful to thee? Thou seekest to please thy consorts. But God is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful

66:2.t: God has already ordained for you,
: and God is your Protector, and He is Full of Knowledge and Wisdom

66:3.t: When the Prophet disclosed a matter in confidence to one of his consorts, and she then divulged it
, and God made it known to him, he confirmed part thereof and repudiated a part. Then when he told her thereof, she said, "Who told thee this? "He said, "He told me Who knows and is well-acquainted

66:4.t: If ye two turn in repentance to Him, your hearts are indeed so inclined; But if ye back up each other against him, truly God is his Protector, and Gabriel, and
righteous one among those who believe,- and furthermore, the angels - will back

66:5.t: It may be, if he divorced you
, that God will give him in exchange consorts better than you,- who submit
, who believe, who are devout, who turn to God in repentance, who worship
and fast, - previously married or virgins

66:6.t: O ye who believe! save yourselves and your families from a Fire whose fuel is Men and Stones, over which are
the Commands they receive from God, but do

66:7.t: , "O ye Unbelievers! Make no excuses this Day! Ye are being but requited for all that ye did

66:8.t: O ye who believe! Turn to God with sincere repentance: In the hope that your Lord will remove from you your ills and admit you to Gardens beneath which Rivers flow,- the Day that God will not permit to be humiliated the Prophet and those who b elieve with him. Their Light will run forward before them and by their right hands, while they say, "Our Lord! Perfect our Light for us, and grant us Forgiveness: for Thou hast power over all things

66:9.t: O Prophet! Strive hard against the Unbelievers and the Hypocrites, and be firm against them. Their abode is Hell,- an evil refuge

66:10.t: God sets forth, for an example to the Unbelievers, the wife of Noah and the wife of Lut: they were
under two of our righteous servants, but they were false to their
, and they profited nothing before God on their accoun t, but were told: "Enter ye the Fire along with

66:11.t: And God sets forth, as an example to those who believe the wife of Pharaoh: Behold she said: "O my Lord! Build for me, in nearness to Thee, a mansion in the Garden, and save me from Pharaoh and his doings, and save me from those that do wrong

66:12.t: And Mary the daughter of 'Imran, who guarded her chastity; and We breathed into
of Our spirit; and she testified to the truth of the words of her Lord and of His Revelations, and was one of the devout

67:1.t: Blessed be He in Whose hands is Dominion; and He over all things hath Power

67:2.t: He Who created Death and Life, that He may try which of you is best in deed: and He is the Exalted in Might, Oft-Forgiving

67:3.t: He Who created the seven heavens one above another: No want of proportion wilt thou see in the Creation of
Most Gracious. So turn thy vision again: seest thou any flaw

67:4.t: Again turn thy vision a second time:
vision will come back to thee dull and discomfited, in a state worn out

67:5.t: , adorned the lowest heaven with Lamps, and We have made such
missiles to drive away the Evil Ones, and have prepared for them the Penalty of the Blazing Fire

67:6.t: For those who reject their Lord
is the Penalty of Hell: and evil is

67:7.t: When they are cast therein, they will hear the
drawing in of its breath even as it blazes forth

67:8.t: Almost bursting with fury: Every time a Group is cast therein, its Keepers will ask, "Did no Warner come to you

67:9.t: They will say: "Yes indeed; a Warner did come to us, but we rejected him and said, 'God never sent down any
: ye are nothing but an egregious delusion

67:10.t: They will further say: "Had we but listened or used our intelligence, we should not
be among the Companions of the Blazing Fire

67:11.t: They will then confess their sins: but far will be
from the Companions of the Blazing Fire

67:12.t: As for those who fear their Lord unseen, for them is Forgiveness and a great Reward

67:13.t: And whether ye hide your word or publish it, He certainly has

67:14.t: Should He not know,- He that created? and He is the One that understands the finest mysteries

67:15.t: It is He Who has made the earth manageable for you, so traverse ye through its tracts and enjoy of the Sustenance which He furnishes: but unto Him is the Resurrection

67:16.t: Do ye feel secure that He Who is in heaven will not cause you to be swallowed up by the earth when it shakes

67:17.t: Or do ye feel secure that He Who is in Heaven will not send against you a violent tornado
, so that ye shall know how

67:18.t: But indeed men before them rejected

67:19.t: Do they not observe the birds above them, spreading their wings and folding them in? None can uphold them except
Most Gracious: Truly it is He that watches over all things

67:20.t: Nay, who is there that can help you,
Most Merciful? In nothing but delusion are the Unbelievers

67:21.t: Or who is there that can provide you with Sustenance if He were to withhold His provision? Nay, they obstinately persist in insolent impiety and flight

67:22.t: Is then one who walks headlong, with his face grovelling, better guided,- or one who walks evenly on a Straight Way

67:23.t: Say: "It is He Who has created you
, and made for you the faculties of hearing, seeing, feeling and understanding: little thanks it is ye give

67:24.t: Say: "It is He Who has multiplied you through the earth, and to Him shall ye be gathered together

67:25.t: They ask: When will this promise be
? - If ye are telling the truth

67:26.t: Say: "As to the knowledge of the time, it is with God alone: I am
only to warn plainly in public

67:27.t: At length, when they see it close at hand, grieved will be the faces of the Unbelievers, and it will be said

67:28.t: Say: "See ye?- If God were to destroy me, and those with me, or if He bestows His Mercy on us,- yet who can deliver the Unbelievers from a grievous Penalty

67:29.t: Most Gracious: We have believed in Him, and on Him have we put our trust: So, soon will ye know which
it is that is in manifest error

67:30.t: Say: "See ye?- If your stream be some morning lost
, who then can supply you with clear-flowing water

68:1.t: Nun. By the Pen and the

68:2.t: Thou art not, by the Grace of thy Lord, mad or possessed

68:3.t: Nay, verily for thee is a Reward unfailing

68:4.t: on an exalted standard of character

68:5.t: Soon wilt thou see, and they will see

68:6.t: Which of you is afflicted with madness

68:7.t: Verily it is thy Lord that knoweth best, which
hath strayed from His Path: and He knoweth best those who receive

68:8.t: So hearken not to those who deny

68:9.t: Their desire is that thou shouldst be pliant: so would they be pliant

68:10.t: Heed not the type of despicable men,- ready with oaths
